check_candle_runtime_capabilities: check if MKL, accelerate, CUDA are available and get the number of threads using candle.utils
create_candle_tensor: create a candle Tensor from a scalar value or a list of numbers using candle.Tensor
perform_tensor_operations: reshape a tensor, compute matrix multiplication with matmul, and transpose with t on a candle Tensor
convert_tensor_dtype: convert a candle Tensor to a different data type like u8 using to_dtype
quantize_and_dequantize_tensor: quantize a candle Tensor to q6k format and dequantize it back to measure reconstruction error
